_comment: CANONICAL activation receipt template — schema naya.activation.receipt.v2. This is the ONE receipt schema enforced by tools/activation_gate.py. v1 (ACTIVATION-RECEIPT-TEMPLATE.json) is retired for pre-delivery enforcement. A receipt is minted by the protected runner at the pre-delivery boundary: repository, main_sha, and loaded fingerprints are resolved from live GitHub state, never supplied by the builder. TRANSPLANT BINDING (round-2): the receipt is bound to its deliverables — deliverables[] lists every file the receipt covers, each with the sha256 of its canonical bytes (receipt marker stripped; the marker cites the receipt so it cannot be part of what the receipt binds, otherwise minting is circular). A receipt presented with different bytes is REJECTED. The delivery gate (pull_request_target, base-pinned code) requires every changed deliverable to be bound. The shipped artifact must carry <!-- NAYA-ACTIVATION-RECEIPT-SHA256:<sha256 of the exact receipt bytes> -->. Repository identity is resolved from the runner-written event payload, cross-checked against GITHUB_REPOSITORY (round-2 trust-root fix).

deliverables.sha256: <64-hex sha256 of the canonical deliverable bytes (receipt marker stripped), resolved at mint time>

job: <one sentence: the real outcome — must match the delivery job context exactly>

loaded._comment: CLOSED-WORLD: keys must be exactly the CANONICAL_SOURCES registry in tools/activation_gate.py; each value the 40-hex blob SHA of that file in the live main tree.

main_sha: <full 40-hex SHA of live main, resolved by the protected runner>
repository: <resolved by the protected runner from the runner event payload>
